$comment: Source of truth for TS and Kotlin. Rules patterns must be portable (JS + java.util.regex): no lookbehind, no named groups. Matched case-insensitively. Remote Config may override weights, riskConfig and thresholds at runtime.

tactics.label: Fast intimacy
tactics.definition: Unusually fast affection, flattery or talk of destiny/soulmates with someone they barely know.

tactics.label: Unverifiable persona
tactics.plain: A life far away that is hard to check
tactics.definition: Claims a hard-to-verify life far away: oil rig, military deployment, doctor abroad, ship engineer, widowed expat.

tactics.label: Moved to another app
tactics.plain: Asked to talk on a different app
tactics.definition: Asks to continue on another app or channel (Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal, private email, a trading app chat).

tactics.label: Asked for secrecy
tactics.plain: Asked you to keep it secret
tactics.definition: Asks them not to tell family, friends or the bank, or to keep the relationship/opportunity private.

tactics.label: Pressure / urgency
tactics.definition: Artificial deadlines, threats, guilt, or "act now or lose out".

tactics.label: Investment pitch
tactics.definition: Promotes crypto, forex or a trading platform with guaranteed, insider or unusually high returns.

tactics.label: Crisis story
tactics.definition: A sudden emergency needing money: medical bill, customs fee, frozen account, stuck abroad, legal trouble.

tactics.label: Too-good job offer
tactics.plain: A job that seems too good to be true
tactics.definition: Easy high-paying job, task-based pay, or a role that needs an upfront fee, equipment purchase or deposit.

tactics.label: Impersonation
tactics.plain: Pretending to be family, a bank or an official
tactics.definition: Claims to be a relative on a new number, a bank, a government agency, or a well-known company or person.
rules: \b(this is my|it'?s me,? this is my|i got a) new number\b

tactics.label: Asked for money
tactics.definition: Directly asks them to send, deposit, lend or "invest" money.

tactics.label: Untraceable payment
tactics.plain: Wants a payment that can't be undone
tactics.definition: Asks for crypto (USDT, BTC), gift cards, wire transfer, P2P to a stranger, or cash courier.

tactics.label: Asked for codes
tactics.plain: Asked for a code or password
tactics.definition: Asks for an OTP, verification code, password, PIN, seed phrase or remote access to a device.
